# WJ76 · Chi tiết agent

Group **WJ · Quản trị agent (Next.js)** · page · Next.js: **exists (design W2)** (`/admin/agents/[id]`) · account `owner`

## Purpose
Agent detail: the same sections as "Agent mới" with a read-only id, plus the knowledge-base sources this agent may read; save with a dirty check.

## Agent and care context
- An agent reads only the sources ticked here (default none); a source not yet approved by a doctor shows "chưa được bác sĩ duyệt".

## Who may see it
- Account in this frame: `owner` (a mock account of `mock/auth.ts`; the back end decides the real matrix, the menu is a convenience).
- Gate: `admin.agents`.
- Roles that can open the page: owner, manager.
- Menu entry: not a menu entry (reached by link, redirect or the shell itself).

## Key actions
- "Quay lại"; "Lưu thay đổi" (disabled until something changed)
- Switch per knowledge-base source and "Lưu nguồn đã chọn"

## Business rules
- Patient safety is a policy profile, never a removed feature: `patient_channel` (the default: messages to patients go to the review queue and a person sends them; memory from patient content is off; image, video, document and web tools are off; a red flag goes to a doctor before any model call; personal data is masked before the model; identity of a Zalo user is confirmed before the assistant names a patient) and `staff_assistant` (internal, staff-only accounts). The profile is set per Zalo account and per agent, the stricter of the two applies (PLAN-AI01 section 5).

- (none: there is no app counterpart to differ from)
